direct_answer: [Saved Reference Analysis] Inspect samples [320..620] (10.67s–20.67s video time) first. Episode 'rollout_T1002_1014_214044' is a policy_rollout where action.* represents 'issued_robot_command' (policy_output_After_chunk_blending_clipped_to_motor_limits), NOT a human leader arm command. In this interval, state.wrist_flex moves from -82.94 deg to -0.83 deg (min -83.12 deg, max 40.31 deg) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=-0.76 deg (max_abs_diff=10.91 deg at sample 403); state.gripper transitions from 35.99 to 40.83 (range 3.20..55.50) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=-0.19 and max_abs_diff=12.51 at sample 421 (14.03s video time).
